time_plan.1h: Compare SPY move to VIX and Treasury futures; confirm whether a cross-asset risk-off pattern is forming or the equity dip is already fading.
time_plan.2h: Assess if any official government statement or White House denial has emerged; if denied, expect mean-reversion and fade the short.
time_plan.6h: Re-evaluate whether the political signal persisted into cash-session volume; measure realized move vs the 700bps tradable threshold.
time_plan.12h: Close window: tally net SPY return, note whether the prediction-market signal led or lagged public reporting, and log calibration error.

predictions.reasoning: A sharp rise in the implied probability that Trump resigns would signal an acute political-stability shock not yet in the public narrative. Sudden regime/leadership uncertainty at the top of the US executive typically triggers risk-off repricing: equities sell off on headline/uncertainty even though constitutional succession (VP) is orderly. The magnitude depends heavily on whether the market move reflects genuine leaked information versus noise; a confirmed resignation announcement could drive a much larger drawdown, while a modest probability drift would move SPY only marginally.

time_plan.2h: Look for official denial/confirmation; a denial likely reverses any haven bid.

time_plan.12h: Close window: record net GLD return and whether it confirmed or contradicted the equity risk-off signal.

predictions.reasoning: Acute US political/leadership uncertainty tends to bid safe havens. If the resignation probability spikes on real information, gold would likely catch a flight-to-safety bid alongside Treasuries. However, gold's reaction to US political drama is historically inconsistent (the dollar can also catch a haven bid, offsetting gold), so this is a weaker, lower-conviction mapping than the equity leg.

evidence_used: Market question concerns resignation of a sitting US president before end of 2026
Resolution triggers on mere announcement, not actual resignation — lowers the bar and raises headline sensitivity
Base rate for a voluntary presidential resignation is extremely low historically
Constitutional succession (Vice President) provides institutional continuity, dampening market reaction
uncertainty_notes: Base probability of this event is very low; most probability moves will be noise, not leaked truth
Orderly VP succession could mute or even neutralize the market reaction
A denial or walk-back would sharply reverse any initial move
Dollar may act as a competing safe haven, muddying the gold thesis

llm_justification.summary: This market maps to a US political-stability shock. A sharp rise in the implied probability of a Trump resignation would, if driven by real information, produce classic risk-off: US equities (SPY) lower and safe havens (gold) higher. But the base rate is tiny, constitutional succession limits the damage, and most probability moves in such a tail market are thin-liquidity noise rather than leaked fact. Both mappings are therefore low-confidence, and only a corroborated, genuine announcement would plausibly clear the 700bps tradable bar.
key_assumptions: A material probability spike reflects some real information rather than pure market noise
US markets treat sudden presidential leadership change as a risk-off event
Liquidity and session timing allow the proxy to actually move within the 12h window
failure_modes: The probability move is thin-market noise with no underlying event — proxies do not move
News is already public and priced, so no incremental asset reaction
Orderly VP succession reassures markets, producing a muted or even relief rally
Dollar absorbs the haven bid, leaving gold flat or lower and breaking that leg
A rapid official denial reverses any initial move before the window closes
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
